Statistical analysis for F2 sd (mid and onset)

Mohammad Abuoudeh
Al-Hussein Bin Talal University

10 septembre 2026

1 Introduction

This document serves as a reference for the statistical analysis workflow, from importing acoustic data to selecting linear mixed models (LMMs) and visualizing marginal effects.

1.1 Data preparation

1.1.1 Loading essential packages

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # p-values pour lmer
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

1.1.2 Loading and data processing

### Charger les données .csv des de l'expérience sur les variations de débit de parole en arabe jordanien collectées .... 10 locuteurs.
Arabic <- read.csv("SpeakingRate24.csv") 

#### Traitements de dataframe

Arabic <- subset(Arabic, select = -Arabic_phrase) ### Supprimer la colonne des phrases en arabe pour éviter les problèmes avec PdfLaTex lors de la compilation LaTex R. Sinon, utiliser XeLaTex pour l'écriture arabe. 
Arabic$CVC <- gsub(' ', '', Arabic$CVC)#supprimer les espaces 
Arabic$V <- gsub(' ', '', Arabic$V)#supprimer les espaces 
Arabic$Length <- gsub(' ', '', Arabic$Length)#supprimer les espaces 

Arabic$f0ons <- as.integer(gsub('--undefined--', NA, Arabic$f0ons))
Arabic$f0mid <- as.integer(gsub('--undefined--', NA, Arabic$f0mid))
Arabic$f0off <- as.integer(gsub('--undefined--', NA, Arabic$f0off))


Arabic <- mutate_if(Arabic, is.character, as.factor) ## Transformer tous les variables de type "character" à des facteurs. 
#Arabic <- filter(Arabic, V!="e:" & V!="o:")
Arabic$V = factor(Arabic$V, levels = c('i','a','u','i:','a:','u:','e:','o:')) ## ordonner l'ordre de l'apparition V
Arabic$C <- factor(Arabic$C, levels=c("b","d","g","t","k")) ## ordonner l'ordre de l'apparition C
Arabic$VOTi <- as.integer(Arabic$VOTi)
Arabic$Word_V_ratio <- as.numeric(gsub(',', '.', Arabic$Word_V_ratio)) #remplacer les virgules en points dans les nombres décimaux pour pouvoir faire des calculs. 

#####Diviser le dateframe en deux sous-ensembles : Sub1 (iaui:a:u:) & Sub2 (iaue:a:o:) pour équilibrer les analyses (avoir le même nombre de voyelles longue vs courte).

### sous-ensemble 1

ArabicSub1 <- Arabic %>% 
  filter(Timbre %in% c("i", "a", "u")) %>% droplevels()

### sous-ensemble 2

ArabicSub2 <- Arabic %>% 
  filter(V %in% c("i", "a", "u", "e:", "o:", "a:")) %>% droplevels()

ArabicSub2$Timbre=gsub('i','e', ArabicSub2$Timbre)
ArabicSub2$Timbre=gsub('u','o', ArabicSub2$Timbre)
ArabicSub2$Timbre= as.factor(ArabicSub2$Timbre)

# #### faire un dataframe avec les SD du F2onset et du F2mid par speaker *rate*length*C ****
# le nombre minimal de données accepté ; n>=2 pour que la SD soit définie
##### for Sub1
Arabicsub1_sd <- ArabicSub1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(F2ons)) %>%
  group_by(Speaker, Length, C, Rate, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    F2onsSD = sd(F2ons, na.rm = TRUE),
    F2midSD = sd(F2mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(F2onsSD), n >= 2) %>%
  filter(is.finite(F2midSD), n >= 2) 

# Vérifier les niveaux
Arabicsub1_sd <- Arabicsub1_sd %>%
  mutate(
    Speaker = droplevels(factor(Speaker)),
    C       = droplevels(factor(C)),
    Length  = droplevels(factor(Length)),
    Rate    = droplevels(factor(Rate))
  )

##### for Sub2
Arabicsub2_sd <- ArabicSub2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(F2ons)) %>%
  group_by(Speaker, Length, C, Rate, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    F2onsSD = sd(F2ons, na.rm = TRUE),
    F2midSD = sd(F2mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(F2onsSD), n >= 2) %>%
  filter(is.finite(F2midSD), n >= 2)

# Vérifier les niveaux
Arabicsub2_sd <- Arabicsub2_sd %>%
  mutate(
    Speaker = droplevels(factor(Speaker)),
    C       = droplevels(factor(C)),
    Length  = droplevels(factor(Length)),
    Rate    = droplevels(factor(Rate))
  )

2 LMMs Model selection : F2onset

2.1 Sub1

lm.1.mod.1 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
lm.1.mod.2 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Rate | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.1.mod.3 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Length | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
lm.1.mod.4 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + C | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.1.mod.5 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Rate + Length | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.1.mod.6 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Rate + C| Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)  
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.1.mod.7 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Length + C | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
## Warning: Model failed to converge with 1 negative eigenvalue: -7.1e-01
lm.1.mod.8 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Rate + Length + C | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.1.mod.9 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate + Length + C + Sex + (1 | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
lm.1.mod.10 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate + Length + C+ Sex + (1 + Length | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
lm.1.mod.11 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate + Length + C +Sex + (1 + Rate | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)  
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.1.mod.12 <- lmer(F2onsSD ~ Rate + Length + C +Sex + (1 + C | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')

The models without singularity issues are lm.1.mod.1,lm.1.mod.3, lm.1.mod.9, and lm.1.mod.10.

#Compairing models:

anova(lm.1.mod.1,lm.1.mod.3, lm.1.mod.9, lm.1.mod.10)

The optimal model is model 10 (the smallest AIC). No interaction.

# updating the optimal model with REML=TRUE. 

lm.1.mod.Optimal1 <- update(lm.1.mod.10, REML = TRUE)
#LMM summary
summary(lm.1.mod.Optimal1)

2.3 Estimated Marginal Means (EMMs)

#  EMMs pour chaque catégorie: Length and Rate

emm_sdons1_rate  <- emmeans(lm.1.mod.Optimal1,  pairwise ~  Rate) #Sub1
emm_sdons2_rate  <- emmeans(lm.2.mod.Optimal1,  pairwise ~  Rate) #Sub2
emm_sdons1_length  <- emmeans(lm.1.mod.Optimal1,  pairwise ~  Length) #Sub1
emm_sdons2_length  <- emmeans(lm.2.mod.Optimal1,  pairwise ~  Length) #Sub2
emm_sdons1_C  <- emmeans(lm.1.mod.Optimal1,  pairwise ~  C) #Sub1
emm_sdons2_C  <- emmeans(lm.2.mod.Optimal1,  pairwise ~  C) #Sub2
# View the pairwise comparisons for main effects
#Sub1
emm_sdons1_rate$contrasts

##  normal - slow    -20.1 8.2 274  -2.446  0.0398
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: Length, C, Sex 
## Degrees-of-freedom method: kenward-roger 
## P value adjustment: tukey method for comparing a family of 3 estimates

2.4 Figure of the EMMeans

As the models do not contain interactions between the main variables, each variable is plotted separately for both subsets and then combined in the same figure to facilitate comparison.

# transform to dataframe
emm_sd_dfons1_rate <- as.data.frame(emm_sdons1_rate$emmeans)
emm_sd_dfons2_rate <- as.data.frame(emm_sdons2_rate$emmeans)
emm_sd_dfons1_length <- as.data.frame(emm_sdons1_length$emmeans)
emm_sd_dfons2_length <- as.data.frame(emm_sdons2_length$emmeans)
emm_sd_dfons1_C <- as.data.frame(emm_sdons1_C$emmeans)
emm_sd_dfons2_C <- as.data.frame(emm_sdons2_C$emmeans)

# to have both subsets in the same figure, we create one dataframe for both subsets for each variable:
#Rate
emm_sd_dfons1_rate$Subset <- "Sub1"
emm_sd_dfons2_rate$Subset <- "Sub2"

###
# Figure with both subsets combined

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5) 

p_rate <- ggplot(df_rate, aes(x = Rate, y = emmean, color = Subset, shape = Subset)) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Estimated F2onset SD (Hz)", x = "Rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p_length <- ggplot(df_length, aes(x = Length, y = emmean, color = Subset, shape = Subset)) +  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "", x = "Length") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p_C <- ggplot(df_C, aes(x = C, y = emmean, color = Subset, shape = Subset)) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "", x = "Consonant") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# linking the three variables using Patchwork

plot_combined <- (p_rate | p_length | p_C) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
  ) & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") &
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(100, 800)) 

plot_combined

################ Figure 2 ##### separate the two subsets inside the figure (more representative and clearer):
# Rate 
p_rate2 <- ggplot(df_rate, aes(x = Rate, y = emmean, color = Subset)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 4) + #16=circle 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(Subset ~ .) + 
  labs(y = "Estimated F2onset SD (Hz)", x = "Rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),       
    strip.background.y = element_blank()  
  )

# Length
p_length2 <- ggplot(df_length, aes(x = Length, y = emmean, color = Subset)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 17, size = 4) + #17=triangle
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(Subset ~ .) +
  labs(y = "", x = "Length") +

  theme(

  )

# C

  facet_grid(Subset ~ .) +
  labs(y = "", x = "Consonant") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold") # 
  )

# linking the 3 variables with Patchwork
plot_combined2 <- (p_rate2 | p_length2 | p_C2) +

3.1 Sub1

lm.3.mod.1 <- lmer(F2midSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
lm.3.mod.2 <- lmer(F2midSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Rate | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
lm.3.mod.3 <- lmer(F2midSD ~ Rate * Length * C + Sex + (1 + Length | Speaker), Arabicsub1_sd, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), REML = FALSE)

## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')

## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')

3.3 Estimated Marginal Means (EMMs)

# The interactions rate:length & C:length were significant. We test these double interactions :

# effect of rate according to length 
emm_mid1_rate_length <- emmeans(lm.3.mod.Optimal1, pairwise ~ Rate | Length) # Sub1

emm_mid2_rate_length <- emmeans(lm.4.mod.Optimal1, pairwise ~ Rate | Length) # Sub2

emm_mid1_C_length <- emmeans(lm.3.mod.Optimal1, pairwise ~ C | Length) # Sub1

# create a dataframe for each interaction for each subset and then bind both sub in the same dataframe :
# interaction Rate * Length
emm_RL1 <- as.data.frame(emm_mid1_rate_length$emmeans) %>% mutate(Subset = "Sub1")
emm_RL2 <- as.data.frame(emm_mid2_rate_length$emmeans) %>% mutate(Subset = "Sub2")
df_RL <- bind_rows(emm_RL1, emm_RL2)

# interaction C * Length
emm_CL1 <- as.data.frame(emm_mid1_C_length$emmeans) %>% mutate(Subset = "Sub1")
emm_CL2 <- as.data.frame(emm_mid2_C_length$emmeans) %>% mutate(Subset = "Sub2")
df_CL <- bind_rows(emm_CL1, emm_CL2)

# Figures
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.3)

plot_RL <- ggplot(df_RL, aes(x = Rate, y = emmean, color = Length, group = Length, shape = Length)) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 4) +
  geom_line(position = dodge, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(Subset ~ .) +
  labs(y = "Estimated F2mid SD (Hz)", x = "Rate", title = "Rate X Length") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

plot_CL <- ggplot(df_CL, aes(x = C, y = emmean, color = Length, group = Length, shape = Length)) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 4) +
  geom_line(position = dodge, linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(Subset ~ .) +
  labs(y = "", x = "Consonant", title = "Consonant X Length") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

# linking figures
plot_interactions <- (plot_RL | plot_CL) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))) & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_interactions

#  EMMs pour chaque C avec toutes les combinaisons  * Length * Rate

emm_sdmid2  <- emmeans(lm.4.mod.Optimal1,  ~  Rate * Length | C) #Sub2
# Résumé sous forme de dataframe

emm_sd_dfmid2 <- as.data.frame(emm_sdmid2)
# Comparaismid par paire de Rate × Length pour chaque C

# Add a column to identify subsets to have both subset on one figure
emm_sd_dfmid1 <- emm_sd_dfmid1 %>% mutate(Subset = "Sub1")
emm_sd_dfmid2 <- emm_sd_dfmid2 %>% mutate(Subset = "Sub2")

# Combine
emm_sd_allmid <- bind_rows(emm_sd_dfmid1, emm_sd_dfmid2)

plot_mid <- ggplot(emm_sd_allmid, aes(x = C, y = emmean, color = Rate, group = Rate)) +
  geom_point(#position = position_dodge(width = 0.3),
    size = 2.5, alpha=0.8) +
  geom_line(#position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
    linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE),
                width = 0.15) +
  #, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  facet_grid(Subset ~ Length) +  # columns = Subset (Sub1 vs Sub2), rows = Length
  labs(y = "Estimated F2mid SD (Hz)", x = "Consonant",
       color = "Rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

plot_mid
